title: Weighted dual-suffix carriers: conditional κ = 7.9961717358e-5
body:
**Full verification passed.** Full repository verification passed on `b054739841f9e106bc15064c79cbc958811a709c` in 2435.331 seconds, completed 2026-10-09T00:40:51.103942+00:00: `make -j1 verify` (78 isolated test modules, 20 historical patch checks), fresh parent/selected producer and certificate regeneration, and ten adversarial controls. All 42 research-head GitHub checks passed, with no source drift. See `research/weighted-dual-suffix/validation.json` for commands and evidence hashes.

Under the inherited analytic, fixed-tape and PR104 stopped-product/odd-grid interfaces,
T(n)=O(n(log n)^(1−κ)) with **κ = 39980858679/500000000000000 = 7.9961717358×10⁻⁵**,
**0.0986743% above PR108**. These general interfaces remain written proof dependencies.

This keeps PR108's complete dual-suffix scalar graph and exact frames, but selects different legal carrier links using weights from the full rank-dependent cost. Both matchings have **15,422 carriers and 43,270 roles**. The improvement comes from their width distribution, not omitted work: the strict complex saving rises from 7989584037/10¹⁴ to **7997468953/10¹⁴**. The bit axis, all 24 retained centers, divisor21, copied-center corrections and all three row stocks remain unchanged.

The discovery step used numerical SciPy assignment. No weighted-optimality claim is made. The explicit link list is checked independently without SciPy:

- Regenerate PR104, PR107 and PR108 producers, retaining all scalar/frame/rational-scatter assertions.
- Recompile the inherited C++ matcher and verify every selected edge and paid histogram entry.
- Independently construct active GF(2) frames in Python, check nondegeneracy and operand nesting, then replay matching uniqueness, shared operands, strict carrier order, exact frame inclusion and the complete histogram.
- Check the exact assembly's **47 constraints and seven margins**, plus rejection of the next complex and κ grid points.
- **Ten controls pass**, including duplicate links, invalid donors, out-of-range uses, corrupted frame ranks, unpaid cleanup, omitted retained loss, mass-preserving histogram mutation and exclusion of PR108 at this saving.
- All **344 source pins** are tracked. The bounded search also tried six structural families and sixteen alternative coordinate layouts; none beat the selected unchanged graph. This is not a global search or optimality claim.

Run:
```
python3 research/weighted-dual-suffix/verify.py
python3 research/weighted-dual-suffix/test_controls.py
make verify
```

Written transfer and scope: `research/weighted-dual-suffix/proof.md`. Optional discovery tool: `optimize.py` (NumPy/SciPy); exact verification does not need those libraries. Dedicated focused CI covers Python3.11,3.13,3.14.
